data.name: NonSense
data.detailed_description:
Non-Sense is a cute-dark 2D narrative adventure RPG about helping Fran rebuild what’s missing—by pushing through surreal nightmares and bringing that hard-won clarity back into everyday life.

By day, you’ll explore familiar places and routines—work, the plaza, therapy, classes, commutes—choosing what to engage with, what to say, and what to focus on. By night, you’ll step into a shifting dream world guided by Moorsh, facing Shadows in tense shooter-style encounters and puzzle-like challenges. Each victory restores a piece of Fran’s perception, opening new interactions, details, and opportunities in the waking world.

Progress isn’t just measured in fights won or paths unlocked, but in the quiet returns: noticing what used to slip by, reconnecting with ordinary moments, and finding the strength to keep showing up.

Key Features

  • Narrative-driven adventure RPG / visual novel blend built around exploration and dialogue choices

  • Two intertwined worlds: grounded daily life and a surreal dream realm with rising intensity

  • Perception-based progression: recover what’s missing in dreams, then use it to reveal new details and unlock new interactions in everyday scenes

  • Puzzles and side activities rooted in ordinary life (including creative and practical tasks)

  • Dream encounters with shooter-style combat mixed with riddle-like beats and story moments

If you’re drawn to story-rich adventures that mix the familiar with the surreal, add Non-Sense to your wishlist—and follow Fran’s journey as the dream world closes in and everyday life starts to change.

data.short_description: Defeat nightmare shadows and restore senses to help Fran navigate through pain and reconnect with everyday life in this cute-dark 2D narrative adventure RPG.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 / Radeon R7 240 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 16:9 displays; game performance may vary on very old integrated GPUs.
